metro-transit-intercity-tran.error: no operator mark in the checked sources
metro-transit-intercity-tran.why: There is no company to give the Puget Sound consolidated feed a feed-wide mark, and the registry brands its rail lines per operator instead: Sound Transit, Amtrak and the City of Seattle streetcars. It previously resolved to Minneapolis's Metro Transit, because King County Metro publishes its agency name as 'Metro Transit' too — a mark for a different agency two thousand kilometres away.
